name: @loopress/cli
description: Build, review and ship WordPress, in one loop: pull, diff, push and roll back a site's code and config from git
author: jean-smaug

warn-if-update-available.message: <%= config.name %> update available: <%= latest %> (you have <%= config.version %>). The CLI and the WordPress plugin evolve together, staying current avoids already-fixed bugs. Update with: npm install -g @loopress/cli

acf.description: Manage ACF or SCF field groups, post types, taxonomies, and options pages (alias: scf)

api.description: Manage custom WordPress REST API routes

app.description: Build and ship single-page app bundles (Vue, React, Svelte...), mounted with a shortcode

content.description: Copy an environment's content (posts, pages, terms) into the local site, never the reverse

cpt.description: Manage custom post types declared in cpt/<slug>.json files, and list every post type on the site

composer.description: Sync composer.json and composer.lock between your project and WordPress

hook.description: Manage hook files: WordPress actions, filters and cron events

menu.description: Manage nav menus and their theme locations

option.description: Manage the wp_options rows the project tracks, only the ones added with lps option add

page.description: Manage static HTML pages rendered inside the theme's header and footer

plugin.description: Manage WordPress.org plugins tracked in loopress.json

project.description: Manage WordPress project and environment configurations

theme.description: Manage everything theme related: versions, block templates and parts, Global Styles, and activating the Loopress child theme

theme:template.description: Manage block templates and template parts, written as the files of the <parent>-loopress child theme

theme:version.description: Manage WordPress.org themes tracked in loopress.json (versions only)

theme:style.description: Manage the active block theme's Global Styles customizations (Site Editor > Styles: colors, typography, spacing)

pattern.description: Manage block patterns declared in patterns/<slug>.html files (registered as loopress/<slug>), and list the theme and plugin ones

role.description: Manage user roles declared in roles/<slug>.json files (never which users have them), and list every role on the site

meta.description: Manage post meta keys declared in meta/<post-type>.json files (never their values), and list every registered meta key

taxonomy.description: Manage taxonomies declared in taxonomies/<slug>.json files (never their terms), and list every taxonomy on the site

scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist && pnpm run schema:types && tsc -b
scripts.version: oclif manifest && oclif readme && git add README.md oclif.manifest.json
